CJP Founder to Proceed with March on July 20 Despite Government Concerns

The CJP (Citizens for Justice and Responsibility) is set to proceed with its march on July 20, despite concerns from the government. The founder of the organization, Abhijeet Dipke, has urged his supporters to gather at Jantar, a public square in Jaipur, Rajasthan. This move comes after Dipke's father criticized the government for not allowing their son to fast indefinitely as a form of protest. The CJP is known for its advocacy on social and economic issues.
